purpose: Resume an interrupted reissue from its first known transaction signature without a second Solana submission or duplicate hosted mutation.
product_outcomes: exact hosted replay returns the committed result without another write
browser preserves the first replacement envelope and transaction signature
resume inspects finality and performs hosted reconciliation only
hosted HTTP and server Devnet reads have explicit time bounds
business_outcome: A and B can recover from an interrupted reissue without risking a second ownership-adjacent transaction.
